mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stays below the prior four-week mean, weekday foot traffic and discretionary stopovers remain suppressed, so RETAIL_REC will stay lower over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days relative to the last 28 days while WORKPLACES remains flat or falls from the current level.

mechanism_narrative: A short-run rise in GROCERY_PHARM diverts trips toward routine necessities and away from shopping and leisure visits, causing RETAIL_REC to weaken within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises at least 2 points above its trailing 2-week average
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 14 days after a clear GROCERY_PHARM increase above the stated threshold.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both strengthen together, commuting intensity expands the pool of people near commercial areas, and RETAIL_REC turns higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays flat or declines over 28 days despite concurrent increases in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: A week-over-week rise in RESIDENTIAL above its recent range indicates more stay-at-home time, which depresses discretionary retail visits and pushes RETAIL_REC down over the next week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL exceeds its trailing 3-week mean by 0.5 points or more
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not drop within 7 days after RESIDENTIAL crosses above its recent mean.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained PARKS weakness reduces mixed-purpose outings and nearby incidental shopping, so RETAIL_REC trends lower over the next four weeks when parks mobility remains depressed.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while PARKS stays below its current four-week level.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT drops sharply while RESIDENTIAL rises, that regime implies substitution into home-centered activity and lower store visits, so RETAIL_REC will fall over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 3 points from its prior week and RESIDENTIAL rises in the same week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days after the specified TRANSIT decline and RESIDENTIAL rise occur together.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent PARKS recovery combined with stable GROCERY_PHARM usually marks a leisure-oriented week that supports downstream shopping trips, so RETAIL_REC should improve over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days even as PARKS rises and GROCERY_PHARM stays stable.

mechanism_narrative: A small but persistent increase in WORKPLACES without a matching rise in RESIDENTIAL indicates looser movement constraints, which should lift RETAIL_REC after a two-week lag.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises above its trailing 4-week average for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise within 14 days after WORKPLACES stays above its trailing 4-week average for two straight weeks.
